title: prdkit.ledger.v1 event envelope
description: Common envelope for every Product-Kit ledger event. Event-specific payload shapes live in the per-event schemas beside this file.

event_id.description: Idempotency key, deterministic per entity described: '<feature-id>/<event>/<discriminator>' (e.g. '019-notifications/review.recorded/T012/round-2'). Required by convention on all events newly added in v0.3.0; adapters deduplicate on it.

operator.description: Human identity attribution (git email or name). Appended by ledger-emit.sh only when the project's task-ledger policy opts in with 'operator: git'.

observed_context.description: Emitter-observed context at this event boundary, distinct from declared project/feature/session metadata. Absent on legacy events. A manifest version is not installation-integrity proof.

repository.description: Credential-free network-origin host/path, or unknown for local/absent/unrecognized origins.
